svg.title: Proposed PDA editor: diagram, table, formal definition and the determinism badge
svg.desc: The PDA editor on a laptop with the Tabel tab open; the Definisi tab; the badge opened to list the competing transitions; the label editor for one edge; and the phone layouts of the Tabel tab and of the label editor.
svg.text: PDA editor (P-004, proposal): the machine wwR, even palindromes, as sample data
Colors and sizes are the design tokens. Words are the Indonesian draft. Numbers 1 to 9 refer to the list in pda-editor.md.
